item.title: Pocket Host 0.11.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #53 `4c9baeb` Thanks @grischaerbe! - The workspace list no longer flashes "Can’t reach …" for a moment when you come back to the app: a connection error shows only once three loads in a row, a second apart, have failed. iPhone and Android alike.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.11.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #49 `07550d7` Thanks @grischaerbe! - With a hardware keyboard, Enter in the message box sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, and ⌘↩ (Ctrl+Enter on Android) queues the message while the agent works, like in Conductor, or sends it otherwise. On iPad the suggestion bar of a hardware keyboard no longer covers the bottom of the message box.
  • #52 `344bf48` Thanks @grischaerbe! - When a chat has an unsent draft on the Mac, the message about it now has an "Overwrite" button: it clears the draft in Conductor and sends your message instead. iPhone and Android alike.

    • Patch Changes

  • #50 `c7896f1` Thanks @grischaerbe! - iPad: the sidebar stays open when you leave the app and come back.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.10.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #46 `42e7314` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Claude knows when you read a chat on your phone. While a chat is open in Pocket, Claude in Conductor gets notes from Pocket's Settings with every prompt: keep replies short, don't ask you to look at the Mac, send links over Tailscale. You can edit the notes or turn this off in Settings → Claude. Pocket Host adds a hook to `~/.claude/settings.json` for this the first time a phone asks. iPhone and Android alike; not for Codex chats.
  • #48 `97a6fbd` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Pocket on iPad is laid out like Conductor: the workspaces in a sidebar, the open workspace beside them with its chats as tabs under the pull request bar (switch, close and open chats there), the chat at a readable width, and keyboard shortcuts (⌘↩ send, ⌘T new chat, ⌘W close chat, ⌘⇧] / ⌘⇧[ next and previous chat, ⌘⇧N new workspace). The iPhone, narrow iPad windows and Android stay as they are.
  • #45 `d40a896` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Videos in chats: videos attached to a prompt and videos an agent puts in its reply (`!…`) show as a thumbnail with a play button, and a tap plays them (in Quick Look on iPhone, with Share to save them; in a full-screen player on Android, with Share). Photo Library now offers videos too, and Choose File takes them; they go to the Mac as they are, up to 1 GB. MP4, M4V and MOV. Needs the new Pocket Host.

    • Patch Changes

  • Android app: "Scan QR code" no longer closes Pocket right away. The scanner couldn't start in the released app.
  • #44 `20a8740` Thanks @grischaerbe! - iPhone: opening a workspace slides the chat's title in smoothly instead of jumping and cutting it off differently halfway through.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.9.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #42 `7b9265f` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Pocket shows changes on the Mac right away: new messages, a chat's state, the workspace list and the pull request bar update about 0.2 s after Conductor writes them, instead of on a 1.5–6 s timer. Pocket Host learns about changes from the operating system (writes to Conductor's database and git caches) and streams them to the phone. Notifications go out sooner too. With an older Pocket Host the apps keep polling as before.
  • #41 `44c68d5` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Pocket Host has a "Name on the phone" field to give the Mac a name of its own instead of the computer name (which macOS sometimes numbers, like "MacBook Pro (1021)"). The apps pick up a new name the next time the workspace list or Settings opens, without pairing again.

    • Patch Changes

  • #38 `47f66c5` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Tapping a workspace in the list loads its chat before it opens: a spinner shows on the row (in place of the chevron on iPhone, of the time on Android) and the chat comes up already filled in. If the Mac takes longer than a few seconds, the chat opens anyway and finishes loading there.
  • #37 `7671769` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Sending from the phone no longer fails with "Conductor has no open window": Pocket Host brings Conductor's window back (closed, minimized or hidden), and starts Conductor first when it isn't running.
  • #43 `9befedd` Thanks @grischaerbe! - Tapping a notification while a chat is open now opens the notification's chat, also in another workspace, instead of only changing the title.
  • #40 `8498e7c` Thanks @grischaerbe! - iPhone: swiping back from a chat to the workspaces slides the chat's title along smoothly instead of making it wobble.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.8.2
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • Chats with subagents look like in Conductor again: what a subagent does stays inside its Agent call instead of filling the chat, and notifications quote the main agent, not a subagent.
